title: Pointwise transfer of weighted approximate tangent spaces under relative L¹-closeness
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (c ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ y ∈ M₁, 0 ≤ θ₁ y) → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → θ₂ x = c * θ₁ x → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ z in closedBall x s, ‖M₂.indicator θ₂ z - c * M₁.indicator θ₁ z‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * ∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₁ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₂ θ₂ x Q
